Chapter 379: Chapter 4 Golden Dragon Star Master: Jin Tianzhao, This Is Your Good Deed! (Please Subscribe)_2

The two were not even on the same track, one was an Evolver genius, the other the founder of an Evolution Path, each excelling in distinctly different fields.

…

Annan Star Alliance official website.

Suddenly, without any noise, an additional name appeared in the fifty-seventh position on the list of councilors.

Shisan.

This change,

...

immediately drew the attention of numerous Evolvers and higher-level citizens.

“What? Our Annan Star Alliance has a new councilor?”

“Identity hidden… I don’t even know which Star Domain that Seventh-Level Citizen is from…”

“Need you ask? It must be someone from our Star Domain.”

“Only your Star Domain can produce Seventh-Level Citizens?”

…

Many Evolvers discussed this heatedly.

Under the long years of the Annan Star Alliance, there were only fifty-six councilors in total, so the sudden appearance of another one naturally sparked much curiosity.

But for most Evolvers, it was just a topic of curious gossip for a while.

After all, Star Alliance councilors… they are too far removed from them, such high and mighty figures, where one might not even find one across dozens of Star Domains, are simply beyond their reach.

“Shisan…”

Shi Feng had just taken a sip of fine wine when he clicked on a link sent by a friend, looked at it, and nearly spat out the wine in his mouth.

“Damn, isn’t this a coincidence?”

Shi Feng found it hard to believe, recalling that he had a friend also named Shisan.

“It can’t be.”

Shi Feng hurriedly contacted Lin Yuan.

…

Personal space.

Lin Yuan sat back leisurely in a recliner, listening to the sound of the creek surrounding him.

“Brother Shisan, I just saw on the list of councilors, there’s an additional name…” Shi Feng asked with a tense voice.

This matter was too incredible, and although it was highly likely a coincidence, he still had to confirm it.

“Hmm… it should be me.”

Lin Yuan said casually, no need to hide once becoming an Annan Star Alliance councilor, as long as he did not expose his true identity.

After all, once becoming a councilor, many benefits of the Annan Star Alliance would naturally come to him, unless Lin Yuan intended to forego these benefits, ultimately he would have to interact with the outside world as ‘Shisan’.

“Really Shisan brother… no, Lord Shisan?”

Shi Feng stared dumbfounded, even though he had speculated as much before coming, it still seemed unbelievable.

Had he, Shi Feng, been previously addressing a lofty councilor as a brother?

“Let us sit and talk.”

Lin Yuan gestured with his hand.

“Yes.” Shi Feng was far from relaxed.

If Lin Yuan were only a Sixth-Level Citizen, he could still joke and laugh, but Seventh-Level Citizens were a completely different class.

Ninety-nine point nine nine percent of Sixth-Level Citizens will never become Seventh-Level Citizens in their lifetimes.

This includes those at the Eighth Layer.

“Lord Shisan…”

Shi Feng was about to speak.

Suddenly his expression changed, he paused for a few breaths, then cautiously said: “People from the Wangyue Starfield have found me, asking if Lord Shisan is the Star Alliance councilor…”

The Annan Star Alliance official website, open to all citizens, a change in the councilors was a significant event for the Star Domain elites as it could impact the future structure of the Star Alliance.

Since the new name of the councilor matched Lin Yuan’s alias, people from the Wangyue Starfield immediately reached out to Shi Feng for confirmation.

“Tell them.”

Lin Yuan said nonchalantly.

“Yes.”

Shi Feng responded respectfully.

“Lord Shisan, people from the Wangyue Starfield would like to meet you…” Shi Feng ventured.

“Let’s meet.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Moments later,

a middle-aged man with a stern face arrived.

It was the Star Lord of the Wangyue Starfield.

The Wangyue Starfield was not a particularly powerful Star Domain, and its Star Lord was merely an ordinary Eighth-Layer Evolver.

“Lord Shisan.”

The Wangyue Starfield’s attitude was slightly respectful.

No matter Lin Yuan’s actual abilities, as long as he could become a Seventh-Level Citizen, his status could rival those peak Eighth-Layer Evolvers, making addressing him as ‘Lord’ quite appropriate.

“What is it?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Wangyue Star Lord.

“Previously, my Wangyue Starfield and Lord had a deal—should you vote for my Starfield, you would receive compensation. Now it appears, my Starfield neglected to provide sufficient compensation…”

The Wangyue Star Lord quickly stated.

“Oh?”

“Too little?”

Lin Yuan seemed to smile.

The Wangyue Star Lord was rather sensible; the conditions previously offered targeted the Sixth-Level Citizen Lin Yuan.

Now that Lin Yuan was a Seventh-Level Citizen, should the Wangyue Starfield play dumb, Lin Yuan would merely vote simply, doing nothing else.

Star Alliance councilors also possess voting power, with each councilor’s vote equal to ten of a Sixth-Level Citizen’s.

“Right.”

“In comparison with Lord Shisan’s status, it was too little.”

The Wangyue Star Lord said: “Lord Shisan must be aware of the disputes between my Wangyue Starfield and the Golden Dragon Star Domain.”

“I know a bit.” Lin Yuan nodded.

The issues between Wangyue Starfield and Golden Dragon Star Domain stemmed from a resource planet.

The border area between Wangyue Starfield and Golden Dragon Star Domain was a swath of space dotted with many Dead Stars.

What is a Dead Star?

It is neither suitable for human habitation nor possesses any resources.

Such worthless planets are known as Dead Stars.

Within the Cosmic Starry Sky, such Dead Stars are most abundant.

And whether it’s a Dead Star or a normal Life Planet, none are static.

Instead, they slowly move their locations, following the many gravitational forces within the Cosmic Starry Sky.

Among them was a Dead Star, moving from the border area between the Golden Dragon Star Domain and Wangyue Starfield into the Wangyue Starfield.
